mission: THE ANGLE-DIRECTION MEASURED ARM CURVE: the hind torque book (b17cbf6c) left the ankle cap doc-derived because NO measured ankle-direction arm curve existed - its BLOCKED cell measured the admitted record's straight-line ankle arms falling 1.8-3.7x short of the 5.9171 N.m Oku measured walk demand. This lane derives the arm-versus-ankle-angle curves for EVERY ankle-crossing muscle in the Wiseman macaque model (SOL, MG, LG, TA, TP, PB, PL, EDL II-V, EHL, FDL II-V, FHL - mined from the model's paths) with the pulley lane's exact tangent-wrapping machinery, verifies them against SI 2's macaque AnkleFE rows (the independent authors' reference) under the k = 0.11975394 scale gate, and computes (1) the ankle cap re-derivation (cap = max over the scan of sum F|r(q)| at the Oku measured walk forces and the PCSA x sigma PROVISIONAL variant, deposit and k-gated scales), (2) the consumption deltas the book could not: the ankle chain's height-law delta (the book's 'delta 0 (blocked)' cell) and the stance-hold ankle node ratios.

The SI 2 AnkleFE rows quoted below were READ from the xlsx (that is what makes them the prior), as were the record forces/arms and the hind book's blocked cells; no derivation code had been run at write time. The measured section at the bottom is appended AFTER the run.

rule0.statement: The ankle torque cap (7.4 N.m) is the last doc-derived hind number because no measured ankle-direction arm curve existed. The Wiseman macaque model's ankle-crossing paths - mined, not assumed: SOL/MG/LG (triceps surae), TA/EDL II-V/EHL (dorsiflexors), TP/PB/PL (peroneal class), FDL II-V/FHL (deep digit flexors) - plus the model's wrap geometry (R_Ankle_Cylinder, rDistalTibia_ellipsoid live during an ankle scan; rProxTibiaCylinder inactive in the deposit) yield measured -dL/dq arm curves by the pulley lane's machinery. SI 2's macaque AnkleFE rows are the independent authors' reference on these same models; the k = 0.11975394 per-taxon scale gate applies and is stated. With the curves measured, cap_new(direction, variant) = max over the measured scan of sum_m F_m x |r_m(q)| closes the hind book's BLOCKED cell: the Oku measured walk forces (MEASURED variant) and the record's PCSA x sigma law (PROVISIONAL variant), on the deposit scale (S1) and the k-gated SI-matched scale (S2), and the height-law delta the book could not compute becomes a number.
rule0.prediction: (1) SHAPE: the derived curves reproduce the SI 2 ankle rows' shape - signs (plantar negative / dorsal positive), the triceps ordering |MG| > |LG| > |SOL| at both endpoints, and per-endpoint agreement within max(0.25 mm, 25% |SI|) under exactly one unit hypothesis (CM, as at knee/MTP); (2) SCALE GATE: the fitted ankle scalar over the point-only ankle muscles (SOL, MG, TA, PB, PL, EHL - no wrap references) lands INSIDE the MTP-class spread [0.1197283, 0.11976842]; the wrapped rows (FDL II-V, FHL, TP) land within the knee-class criterion |derived x k - SI| <= max(0.25 mm, 25% |SI|); (3) WRAPS: R_Ankle_Cylinder engages on R_FDL_TENDONII/III/IV, R_FHL and R_TP somewhere in every scan (zero events on a load-bearing ankle pulley = the direction fails); FDL V's ellipsoid engagement is recorded with its true (possibly partial) extent; (4) CAP: the plantarflexion V1_S1 cap is BELOW the current doc cap 7.4 (delta NEGATIVE, band [5.4, 6.9] N.m) but EXCEEDS the Oku walk demand peak 5.9171 - the measured arms close the walk the record's straight-line arms fell 3.7x short of; the coverage is carried by FDL's inclusion and the triceps-only sub-envelope does NOT cover (band [4.3, 5.5]); (5) V2_S1 (PCSA x sigma, PROVISIONAL) exceeds V1_S1 (band [14.5, 23.5]); (6) S2 COLLAPSE: both k-gated plantar caps fall far below the demand (V1_S2 band [0.60, 0.90], V2_S2 band [1.6, 2.9]) - the k gate, exactly as the hind book measured at knee/MP; (7) CONSUMPTION: the stance-hold binding ankle node 7.215 N.m EXCEEDS the V1_S1 plantar cap - over-cap ankle stance-hold nodes RISE from 0, and the ankle chain's height-law authority factor (cap_new / 7.396) lands in [0.73, 0.94] at V1_S1 (NEGATIVE delta - the measured book TIGHTENS the height chain the doc cap was padding) while the V2_S1 factor is POSITIVE; (8) the derivation is byte-deterministic and every number traces to a sha-pinned input.
rule0.falsifier: (a) any compared muscle whose arm shape misses: unit verdict not exactly-one, sign mismatch, triceps-ordering violation, ankle k outside the MTP spread, or a wrapped row outside the k-scaled tolerance - each recorded with its number (the LG row carries a named advance suspect: its rProxTibiaCylinder wrap is active=false in the deposit while the authors' model may route it); (b) zero wrap contacts on R_Ankle_Cylinder for any of FDL II/III/IV, FHL, TP across its scanned range; (c) any pre-registered delta SIGN measured opposite or any band missed - recorded as FIRED with the number, never tuned; (d) two full in-process derivations disagreeing at any byte, or a subprocess rerun disagreeing; (e) any number whose provenance chain does not resolve to a sha-verified input and key path; (f) any file changed outside tools/science_funnel/validation/ankle_arms_20260921/. Any hit is recorded as measured.

protocol_declared.scan_protocol: identical to the pulley lane: the named coordinate r_ankle_flexion over EACH muscle's SI 2 recorded jrange (2001 samples, degrees -> radians, recorded order preserved), all other coordinates at model-file defaults, fd = -dL/dq central differences step 1e-4 rad (authoritative), advisory geometric arm = signed perpendicular distance from the ankle pin axis to the joint-spanning line of action; wrap resolution exactly the pulley machinery's (cylinder tangent + quadrant + <=pi arc, ellipsoid iterative refinement, endpoint-inside raises); the machinery is IMPORTED from the sha-pinned pulley module, not re-implemented

direction_classes_and_force_variants.sign_law: a muscle contributes F x |r(q)| to a direction's cap at sample q only when its arm's SIGN matches the direction (plantarflexion = negative arms, dorsiflexion = positive arms under r = -dL/dq); a sign-flipping muscle (FDL V) contributes only on its matching-sign sub-window - the abs() shortcut the hind book could take on fixed-sign classes is NOT taken here because EDL II-V and FDL V change side
direction_classes_and_force_variants.V1_oku_walk_peaks: MEASURED-demand variant: SOL 214.99 N whole; GAS 125.8 N split across MG/LG by the record's PCSA share (MG 0.4534 / LG 0.5466 - group force measured, intra-group split not, same law as the hind book's vasti); FDL 204.57 N split EQUALLY across tendons II-V (one muscle, four slips, no measured partition - the hind book's declared law); TA 63.87 whole and EDL 24.2 quarter-split across II-V on the DORSIFLEXION side. EXCLUDED - named gaps (no Oku measurement): TP, PB, PL, FHL, EHL. Declared sub-envelope: triceps-only (SOL+MG+LG, FDL excluded) - the no-cross-joint-force-reuse reading, since FDL's Oku force is also the hind book's MTP cap input
